source.quote: Rotel's own page for the RAS-5000, read 2026-11-25. « Coax/Optical Digital Input Signals » / « SPDIF LPCM (Up to 24-bit/192kHz) ». « PC-USB » / « USB Audio Class 2.0 (up to 24-bit/384kHz)* ». « MQA and MQA Studio (up to 24-bit/384kHz ) ». HDMI: « Support eARC function », with no rate. DAC: « ESS premium 32-bit Digital to Analog Converter » (feature icon). No DSD row and no digital filter row.

facts.chip: « ESS premium 32-bit Digital to Analog Converter » - no part number.

_verification_des_conditions_tentee: No terms page is linked from rotel.com's home page, its product listing or the product pages read; the footer offers Contact Us, a Privacy Policy and « (c) Grand Green Limited ». The privacy policy WAS read and covers registrations, mailing lists and analytics, with no clause on using or reproducing site content. No URL was guessed, so a terms page elsewhere on the site is not ruled out.
_un_eARC_annonce_et_jamais_chiffre: « Support eARC function » and nothing else about it. A fitted HDMI input with no published ceiling, so no hdmi block. Fourth record in the catalogue in that position after the Cambridge CXN100 SE, the Bluesound NODE ICON and the Arcam pair - and on three of the four the maker rates every other input and leaves HDMI bare.
